description: Mobile Village at DEF CON 25 covers mobile security and wireless exploitation with 4 talks on LTE impersonation, GPS spoofing, NFC vulnerabilities, and Android reverse engineering.

talks.title: Ghost Telephonist Impersonates You Through LTE CSF
talks.teaser: LTE cellular network impersonation attacks enabling identity spoofing and call interception.

talks.title: Using GPS Spoofing to Control Time
talks.teaser: GPS spoofing techniques to manipulate location-based systems and time-dependent functions.

talks.title: Man in the NFC
talks.teaser: NFC interception and relay attacks on mobile payment and communication systems.

talks.title: Ghost in the Droid: Possessing Android Applications with ParaSpectre
talks.teaser: Advanced Android application possession and hijacking techniques using ParaSpectre.
